title: kbingest where's map digest covers only the mapper module's own file, so a change to a helper module the mapper imports leaves a stale cached map
goal: kbingest where rebuilds its cached map when a module a group mapper imports from its own directory changes, not only the mapper module

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def R(*a,env=None):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,**(env or {})),timeout=600)
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(T/"r"),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
(T/"r").mkdir(); git("init","-q","-b","main"); git("config","user.name","t"); git("config","user.email","t@corp.example.com")
(T/"r"/"a.foo").write_text("hello\n"); git("add","a.foo"); git("commit","-qm","base")
e=T/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"gfoo.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=0.1\"\nimport gfoo_helper\nSUFFIXES=[\".foo\"]\ndef mapper(repo_dir, rev, files):\n    return {\"symbols\":[{\"name\":gfoo_helper.NAME,\"kind\":\"function\",\"path\":f,\"line\":1} for f in files]}\n")
(e/"gfoo_helper.py").write_text("NAME = \"alpha\"\n")
g=T/"g.json"; g.write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"ingest_mappers":{"foo":"gfoo:mapper"}},"extension_paths":[str(e)]}))
env={"KB_GROUP_SETTINGS":str(g)}
r=R("_tools/kbingest.py","where","alpha","--repo",str(T/"r"),env=env)
assert "a.foo" in r.stdout, ("first where", r.stdout[-300:], r.stderr[-300:])
(e/"gfoo_helper.py").write_text("NAME = \"beta\"\n")
r=R("_tools/kbingest.py","where","beta","--repo",str(T/"r"),env=env)
sys.exit(0 if "a.foo" in r.stdout else "not yet: where reused the map after a helper module changed: "+r.stdout[-300:])
